description: This file is a JUnit test class for the EntityTagMatchersValueValidator in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers package. It tests validation logic for EntityTagMatchers value parsing, including handling of null inputs, validity checks, and immutability.

classes.name: EntityTagMatchersValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the EntityTagMatchersValueValidator, testing validation logic and immutability.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Static method to set up class-level test data, initializes a valid entity tag matchers string.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test preconditions, mocks header definition, and initializes the validator instance.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that EntityTagMatchersValueValidator and its associated ValueValidator are immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullEntityTagMatcherValueValidator
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to getInstance throws NullPointerException with expected message.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Checks that accepting a null definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Verifies that a null value string throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Tests that a valid entity tag matcher string is accepted without exceptions.

methods.name: canValidateEntityTagMatchers
methods.description: Checks that the validator reports it can validate EntityTagMatchers.class.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequenceWithSpaces
methods.description: Tests validation with a string containing spaces to ensure parsing still succeeds.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotEntityTagMatchers
methods.description: Confirms that validation does not run for unrelated header definitions.

methods.name: acceptNonEntityTagMatchersString
methods.description: Tests rejection of a non-entity-tag string with appropriate exception.

methods.name: acceptInvalidEntityTagMatchersString
methods.description: Tests rejection of an invalid entity tag string with proper exception details.
